task: Prepare a Loaded Burrito: tortilla, cooked rice, cooked steak, chopped tomato, and chopped lettuce, plated in this order.
timingNote: Recorded text interaction. Synthetic voices added for presentation; playback is time-expanded. Tick stamps preserve the original sequence.

dialogue.speaker: user
dialogue.text: What should I start with?

dialogue.speaker: user
dialogue.text: Still waiting to hear what to do first.

dialogue.speaker: assistant
dialogue.text: Start by going to the plate stack with empty hands and picking up a clean plate. Then go to the tortilla crate and scoop one raw tortilla onto it—it must be first. We'll add cooked rice next.

dialogue.speaker: user
dialogue.text: Got it, grabbing a plate and tortilla.

dialogue.speaker: user
dialogue.text: Tortilla is on. How do I prep the rice?

dialogue.speaker: assistant
dialogue.text: Put your tortilla plate down on an empty counter first. With empty hands, go to the rice crate and pick up one rice. Go to the pot by the left wall, put down the rice, then turn on with empty hands. Pick your plate back up and return to that pot; when its progress bar is full, scoop the cooked rice onto the plate. Rice needs no chopping.

dialogue.speaker: user
dialogue.text: Parking the plate and getting the rice started.

dialogue.speaker: user
dialogue.text: Give me a shout the moment the rice is done, would you?

dialogue.speaker: assistant
dialogue.text: Will do—the rice is cooking but isn't done yet. Pick up your tortilla plate and return to the pot by the left wall so you're ready to scoop.

dialogue.speaker: user
dialogue.text: Rice is on. What should I do next?

dialogue.speaker: user
dialogue.text: Got the rice on. What's next?

dialogue.speaker: user
dialogue.text: Rice is scooped. What is the next step?

dialogue.speaker: assistant
dialogue.text: Next, prep the steak. Put your plate down on an empty counter, pick up one steak from the steak crate, and put it on the cutting board nearest the left-wall pot. Chop until finished—about four chops—then pick it up, put it in a pan, and turn on with empty hands. Pick your plate back up so you're ready to scoop when the steak is cooked.

dialogue.speaker: user
dialogue.text: Parking plate and prepping the steak now.

dialogue.speaker: user
dialogue.text: How many cutting boards are free right now?

dialogue.speaker: assistant
dialogue.text: Two cutting boards are free—the pair on the lower-middle counter. The board by the left-wall pot holds your finished chopped steak. Pick it up next and put it in a pan, then turn on with empty hands.

dialogue.speaker: user
dialogue.text: Grabbing the chopped steak now.

dialogue.speaker: assistant
dialogue.text: You've paused since adding the steak. Next, put your plate down on an empty counter, pick up a tomato from the tomato crate, and put it on the cutting board by the left-wall pot. Chop until finished; then retrieve your plate and scoop the chopped tomato onto it.

dialogue.speaker: user
dialogue.text: Right, moving on to the tomato now.

dialogue.speaker: user
dialogue.text: The thing I put on right after the tortilla — what is it, and is it done?

dialogue.speaker: assistant
dialogue.text: That was rice, and yes—it was fully cooked before you scooped it onto the tortilla. Next, put the tomato you're holding on the cutting board by the left-wall pot and chop until finished.

dialogue.speaker: user
dialogue.text: Tomato is scooped. What should I do next?

dialogue.speaker: assistant
dialogue.text: Lettuce is last. Put your plate down on an empty counter, pick up one lettuce from the lettuce crate, and put it on the cutting board by the left-wall pot. Chop until finished, then retrieve your plate and scoop the chopped lettuce onto it. After that, go to the serving pass and serve.

dialogue.speaker: user
dialogue.text: Parking plate, chopping lettuce next.

dialogue.speaker: assistant
dialogue.text: You've picked up a second raw lettuce; your chopped lettuce is already ready on the board by the left-wall pot. Go to the trash and trash the raw lettuce. Then pick up your existing plate from the left-wall counter below the pot and scoop the chopped lettuce from the board. After that, go to the serving pass and serve.

dialogue.speaker: user
dialogue.text: Oh right, grabbing the plate now.

dialogue.speaker: assistant
dialogue.text: Your hands are empty now, so you can leave that extra lettuce on the board. Pick up your existing plate from the left-wall counter below the pot, then scoop the finished chopped lettuce from the board by that pot.

actions.text: go to the empty cutting board
